content.text:
This is the first note published through the Scholar workspace. It is here so the publishing contract can be inspected rather than described.

A published essay is a signed snapshot. The author signs the exact text and rights in the workspace; the submission service writes that snapshot to a public Git branch; a release then projects the branch into this reader. Signing does not mean the claim is true, and publishing does not mean it has been reviewed. Both are separate, recorded decisions.

Permission for machine use is also separate. An author may allow an exact published version to be used in answers, in drafting, or neither, and may revoke either at any time. No permission is inferred from publication.

This note is an editorial record, not a scholarly argument. Its purpose is to make the contract visible: source, signature, branch, release, permission — each step inspectable and each step reversible.
